biological_replicate: OVCAR3 cells (KRASWT or KRASG12D) treated with different antibodies/vehicle

Five hundred thousand OVCAR3 (transduced with wild-type or G12D mutated KRAS, fused with PAmCherry) cells were placed in 100mm × 20mm cell culture plates and treated with or without anti-human KRASG12D-IgA1 or KRASG12D-IgG4 or non-specific human IgA (Abcam, ab91025) at 0.5 μg/ml final concentration or vehicle (PBS)
